name: Opening payment tracking requests the payment stream once
title: SC-09-01-03 Opening payment tracking requests the payment stream once
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site manager is in the dues management view
When the site manager opens the payment tracking module
Then exactly one payment stream request is sent
And the stream shows the data of that request, not a superseded response
